environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB) with a simple HTTPS listener forwarding all traffic to the target group on port 8080. ALB has no associated WAF WebACL. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and 8080 from ALB security group to instance. The application is accessed directly via the ALB DNS name.
